diagnosis_verbatim.statement: gpt2 is not a model without a workspace; it is a model that is weak at everything. Its readrate of 0.0078 at layer 9 is about 390 times the chance rate of roughly 1/50257 = 2e-5. It really is reading content out, just weakly. Using a weak model as the null gives not a null hypothesis but a small signal, and any rule defined RELATIVE TO A PROFILE'S OWN MAXIMUM will produce a band on a small signal. OD-015's failure is structural; changing the threshold cannot close it.

directional_fact.statement: rank-1 is about 3 times easier for gpt2 by vocabulary size alone, so the 10.85x separation already observed is CONSERVATIVE

revision_1_negative_control_becomes_a_ma.construction: per layer, replace J_l with a random matrix of the SAME Frobenius norm, leaving the entire rest of the readout path unchanged
revision_1_negative_control_becomes_a_ma.provenance: this is the construction EQ1 already registered and used for kappa_null; it is transplanted to the rank pipeline rather than invented here
revision_1_negative_control_becomes_a_ma.properties: same model, same items, same positions, same vocabulary; the only difference is that the lens carries no Jacobian information
revision_1_negative_control_becomes_a_ma.one_per_evaluated_model: including the target when it is eventually evaluated
revision_1_negative_control_becomes_a_ma.gpt2_status: demoted to a DESCRIPTIVE control; still reported, no longer a gate

revision_2_band_criterion.definition: band = the longest contiguous mid-depth run of layers whose readrate significantly exceeds the random-lens null upper confidence bound
revision_2_band_criterion.null_ceiling: the MAXIMUM of the per-replicate upper confidence bounds, which is the conservative direction
revision_2_band_criterion.confidence_level_justification: a statistical convention, not a value selected to fit the data
revision_2_band_criterion.significance_test: binomial confidence interval over item x intermediate trials
revision_2_band_criterion.removed_from_od_015: the scale-free 'at least half of the profile's own maximum' rule, which is the element that failed

revision_3_non_vacuity_must_be_demonstra.requirement: before this criterion touches any real profile, three negative cases must be demonstrated
cases: feed the random lens's OWN profile to the band extractor -> must yield NO band
feed a pure noise profile -> must yield NO band
feed an all-zero profile -> must yield NO band
revision_3_non_vacuity_must_be_demonstra.gate: the criterion may not be applied to any real data until all three pass
revision_3_non_vacuity_must_be_demonstra.why_this_is_the_dividing_line: this is what separates the amendment from 'look at the answer, then pick a ratio that passes'. The non-vacuity of this criterion can be proven independently, BEFORE touching any real profile.

honest_labelling_verbatim: This amendment was made, in time, after the positive, depth and negative control numbers had been seen, and is labelled post-hoc accordingly. Its validity does not depend on those numbers: non-vacuity is proven independently by the three negative cases above, and the confidence level is a statistical convention rather than a fitted value. The amendment was carried out entirely against non-target models; the target was not touched when it was made, lens_A and lens_B were not read, and the OD-012 guard records zero lens reads.

status_changes.HB-002: retained as a recorded blocker, LIFTED by OA-004, following the HB-001 / OA-001 pattern
status_changes.OD-015: marked SUPERSEDED BY OA-004; its original text and the evidence of its failure are retained, not deleted

what_this_amendment_does_not_do: it does not retract HB-002 or pretend the stop did not happen
it does not delete OD-015 or the evidence that it failed
it does not relax any EQ1 threshold
it does not permit reading the sealed lenses any earlier
it does not change the rule that if neither kurtosis convention matches, the invocation continues rather than stopping
claim_ceiling: A criterion amendment. It licenses no claim of any kind.
